_note: Authored exceptions for the lesson adaptation layer (shared/supports/lesson-supports.js). Data, not code: a lesson that needs special handling is recorded here rather than as a lesson-id branch in a renderer. Every key is optional and every lesson defaults to the generic rules. Validated by tools/validate-lesson-supports.mjs.

_fields.computationIsObjective: true when the lesson's objective IS the computation. Suppresses the calculator toggle, because offering it there would remove the thing being learned.
_fields.factRecallIsObjective: true when recall of multiplication facts IS the objective. Suppresses the multiplication chart for the same reason.
_fields.pin: support keys whose content must stay visible even under reduced visual load — e.g. a geometry figure whose labels ARE the mathematics.
_fields.exclude: support keys never offered for this lesson, with a reason. Use sparingly.

_reviewNote: The computationIsObjective set below is drawn from lesson titles that name the algorithm as the objective. It is an instructional judgement, not a derivation, and it is recorded here rather than inferred at runtime so it can be argued with and changed in one place. Everything absent from this file defaults to offering the calculator, which is correct for the reasoning-objective majority of the curriculum.
